title: Thinking on Designing Expectations
summary: Kahran and Divya think about expectations as a design material — how pre-experiences shape what your audience will feel, and why 'quality is whatever meets the spec' (Seth Godin) is the antidote to perfectionism. They cover fine dining where the chef also makes the plates, why Miyamoto's Mario delay logic doesn't apply to products, and how clearly framing what something is supposed to be makes it easier to finish.

intents.display: to think about how expectations design the experience that follows
